item.subject: science
item.stem:
Anika studies two garden plants.
Plant P is shorter than a tree and has many hard brown woody stems that branch close to the ground.
Plant Q is a tall plant with one main thick woody trunk and branches high above the ground.

Which claims classify the plants correctly? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: Plant P is a shrub — many hard woody stems branch close to the ground.
options.B: Plant Q is a tree — one main thick woody trunk with branches high above the ground.
options.C: Plant P is a herb — it is shorter than a tree.
options.D: Plant Q is a climber — woody stems mean it needs support.
